qualifier: IGF response, apoptosis and muscle atrophy
name: AKT-FOXO signalling in IGF response and cell death
rationale: All members concern PI3K/AKT control of FOXO localisation and transcription and its outputs (IGF/peptide response, neuronal and hormone-mediated apoptosis, muscle atrophy), whereas confusables pair FOXO with NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1 or HSF1 stress programmes.

name: DNA topological remodelling in replication and repair
rationale: Members cover DNA geometric/topological change, fork reversal, protein-DNA complex disassembly and regulation of strand elongation, NER and damage-linked telomere maintenance, unlike confusables centred on telomere capping, chromatin/ADP-ribosylation or replication-stress responses.

name: Regulation of toll-like receptor signalling and inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulators of TLR (TLR2/3/4, MyD88, TRIF), IL-1, CD40 signalling and of IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-1, TNF and IFN-alpha production, distinct from confusables on T-cell suppression, TRIF/TAK1 mechanics or inflammasomes and LPS detection.

name: Promotion of sprouting angiogenesis and vessel branching
rationale: All members are positive drivers of angiogenic sprouting, endothelial proliferation, migration and branching, whereas confusables are dominated by negative regulation and VEGF/FGF production control.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic terms centred on proline synthesis/catabolism, glycine synthesis and glyoxylate, distinguishing them from confusables on histidine/threonine, aromatic amino acids, serine/vitamin B6 or generic organic acids.

qualifier: end resection, repair route choice and BRCA/PALB2 defects
name: Double-strand break resection, repair routes and BRCA/PALB2 defects
rationale: All members concern DSB sensing, end processing and repair by HR, SDSA, SSA, MMEJ or NHEJ including BRCA1/BRCA2/BARD1/PALB2 loss-of-function, whereas confusables emphasise ADP-ribosylation and chromatin at breaks or strand invasion and crosslink repair.

name: Replication origin licensing and E2F-regulated replication initiation
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, E2F control and ATR replication checkpoint, distinct from confusables on general cell-cycle/E2F transcription modules, G1/S transcription or intra-S damage checkpoints.

Members are unrelated promoter-motif gene sets, glucocorticoid receptor targets, a vascular/mesenchymal adhesion signalling module and a megakaryocyte-platelet module, sharing no nameable biological process.

name: Reelin signalling in dendrite and synapse maturation
rationale: Members combine reelin signalling with dendrite development, spine maintenance/morphogenesis, synapse maturation and plasticity, and reelin is what confusables (actin/postsynaptic density, amyloid-beta, LTP) lack.

name: RHOA-type and CDC42-type Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOJ, RHOD and RHOG with formin activation, whereas confusables are built around atypical RHOU/V, RND and RHOF cycles.

name: ESCRT-dependent viral budding and non-lytic release
rationale: All members describe enveloped virus (HIV) budding and non-lytic release via multivesicular-body sorting machinery, whereas confusables use ESCRT for abscission and nuclear envelope sealing or concern HIV Nef/Vpu host modulation.

name: TLR3-TRIF-TBK1 signalling to IRF3/7 and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR trafficking, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/IRF7 and TLR3, TICAM1, UNC93B1 and TRAF3 deficiencies in HSE, unlike confusables on cGAS/STING, RIG-I, TLR7/8/9 or interferon-stimulated gene responses.

qualifier: brush border, tight junctions and raft protein sorting
name: Epithelial apical brush border, tight junctions and raft sorting
rationale: Members concern microvillus/brush border assembly, tight junctions and paracellular transport, and polarised Golgi-to-membrane and raft protein localisation, distinct from confusables on CFTR/water transport, bile lipid flippases or podocyte polarity.

core: Host regulation of viral life cycle
name: Host regulation of viral entry and release
rationale: Members are general positive and negative regulation of viral entry, transport, life cycle and release, whereas confusables are virus-specific attachment/entry pathways or regulation of viral genome replication.

name: Ephrin and L1 signalling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members combine EPH-ephrin repulsion and growth cone collapse, L1 signalling/recycling, DCC attraction, RAC1 activation and axonal fasciculation, whereas confusables centre on netrin/ROBO-SLIT signalling or filopodium regulation.

name: Endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport and trans-Golgi sorting
rationale: Members cover early/late endosome-to-Golgi and TGN retrograde transport, Golgi retention, COPI-independent Golgi-to-ER traffic and lysosome vesicle biogenesis, unlike confusables on COPI/intra-Golgi traffic or anterograde Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome delivery.

qualifier: protein import and inner membrane organisation
name: Mitochondrial respiratory chain biogenesis and protein import
rationale: Members span respiratory complex I-IV and ATP synthase assembly, electron transport, Fe-S clusters, mitochondrial protein import/processing and cristae formation, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial RNA import, heme/ubiquinol synthesis or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: lateral plate mesoderm, gut and pericardial morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation mesoderm migration and lateral plate mesoderm morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover germ layer formation, mesodermal/mesenchymal migration, lateral plate mesoderm and its gut, heart and pericardium derivatives, whereas confusables emphasise endoderm specification, primitive streak and pluripotency factors.

name: Regulation of calcium-dependent synaptic vesicle fusion and exocytosis
rationale: All members regulate the calcium-triggered or spontaneous fusion step of neurotransmitter release, distinct from confusables on vesicle docking/priming, transmitter-specific release cycles or presynaptic GABA/glutamate modulation.

name: Growth hormone and thyroid hormone control of somatic growth
rationale: Members combine GH receptor/JAK-STAT and IGF signalling for organism growth with thyroid hormone transport, activity and response, the thyroid arm being absent from leptin/prolactin confusables and the GH arm absent from the thyroid confusable.

name: Glutamate, alanine and aspartate metabolism linked to gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, alanine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism, nitrogen utilisation, oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis, distinct from confusables on glycine conjugation, TCA intermediates or proline/glyoxylate metabolism.

name: Thyroid hormone generation and PAPS-dependent sulfonation
rationale: Members combine iodide transport, H2O2 and thyroid hormone generation/transport with PAPS metabolism and cytosolic sulfonation (plus selenium reduction), and the sulfonation arm is what all confusables lack.

name: Tachykinin signalling and urogenital smooth muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation in micturition, erection, parturition, insemination and peristalsis with tachykinin receptor signalling, distinct from adrenergic vascular, GnRH/G-protein calcium or gastric confusables.

name: Nephron proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis, nephron patterning and development of distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct segments, unlike confusables on ureteric bud, nephric duct or renal vesicle/MET.

name: Cardiac conduction system and atrioventricular canal development
rationale: Members concern development of sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodes, His-Purkinje system, AV canal and cardiomyocyte fate, distinct from confusables on gap-junction conduction physiology or ventricular/septal heart morphogenesis.
